releaseNotes: HWM 0.2.5.11 fixes the workstation tray crash seen when opening HWM on affected endpoints. Tray 1.0.0.7 prevents WinForms from recreating the native window handle when ShowInTaskbar changes after startup, eliminating the repeated GDIObjectLeak and USER32 stack overflow 0xc00000fd failure. Service 0.2.5.10 is included. Existing updater verification, rollback, 15 minute checks, terminal and Mesh recovery behaviour remain unchanged.
